title: Exceptions
summary: try/except/else/finally, raising errors, custom exception classes and exception chaining.
hints: `parse_int`: `try: return int(text.strip())` and `except ValueError: return default`. `safe_divide`: catch `ZeroDivisionError` and return `None`. Always catch the specific exception you expect, never a bare `except:`.

`InsufficientFunds`: subclass `Exception`, store `needed` and `available` on `self`, and call `super().__init__(f"need {needed}, have {available}")` so `str(error)` reads well. In `withdraw`, check `amount <= 0` first (raise `ValueError`), then `amount > balance` (raise `InsufficientFunds(amount, balance)`).

`parse_age`: wrap only the conversion: `try: age = int(text)` / `except ValueError as e: raise ValueError("age must be a whole number") from e`. Then check the range outside the `try`. `first_error`: loop, `try: fn()` / `except Exception as e: return type(e).__name__`; return `None` after the loop.
